description: A sleek, form-fitting jumpsuit made of a stretchy, breathable fabric. It has several utility pockets and a sturdy zipper. It looks comfortable and practical.
name: Jumpsuit

params.message: The jumpsuit is made of a sleek, matte fabric that seems to repel dust. The pockets are deep and reinforced. A small label inside reads: 'Property of Task Facility 5'. It looks like it would fit you perfectly.
You zip up the jumpsuit. It fits like a second skin, and the fabric seems to regulate your temperature comfortably.
You unzip and step out of the jumpsuit, folding it neatly.
